question: Choose the correct one-word substitute: “A formal tribute praising someone greatly.”
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Panegyric**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"panegyric"** means a formal public speech or written verse, delivered in high praise of a person or thing. (किसी व्यक्ति की प्रशंसा में औपचारिक भाषण या लेख – प्रशस्ति)

 
 
• **Example:** The retiring professor received a heartfelt panegyric from his colleagues at the farewell ceremony.
 
 
 
• **"Panegyric"** refers specifically to elaborate praise, often in a public context. (प्रशस्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** The author’s new book is essentially a panegyric to her mentor.
 
 
 
• Hence, a formal tribute praising someone greatly is called a **panegyric**.

Therefore, the correct answer is- Panegyric

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Elegy** (शोकगीत): A poem of serious reflection, typically a lament for the dead.

 
 
• **Example:** The poet wrote an elegy after the loss of his friend.
 
 
 
• **Parable** (नैतिक कथा): A simple story used to illustrate a moral or spiritual lesson.
 
 
• **Example:** The parable of the Good Samaritan teaches kindness.
 
 
 
• **Monologue** (स्वगत भाषण): A long speech by one actor in a play or movie.
 
 
• **Example:** The actor’s monologue captivated the entire audience.
